name: Access to Chrome or Edge Registry Configuration
description: Detects access to general configuration keys for Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge, such as installation path or version. This is often a reconnaissance step before attempting data theft or exploitation.

action.description: A process queried general configuration information for a major web browser.

operational_usage: This is a low-noise feature for tracking reconnaissance. While many legitimate applications query these keys to open links, queries from non-interactive processes, command-line tools, or scripts are suspicious and should be correlated with other activities.
false_positive: Frequent. Any application that needs to launch a web browser will query these keys. The value is in identifying anomalous querying processes.
